import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.405
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*v + params[3]*np.exp(-v) + params[4]*x*v
            + params[5]*x*x*v + params[6]*c + params[7]*s + params[8]*c*v + params[9]*s*x)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.3
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*v + params[3]*x*v + params[4]*v*v
            + params[5]*np.sin(v) + params[6]*v*np.abs(v) + params[7]*c + params[8]*s + params[9]*c*x)
